verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway ships an explicit 'AI MCP Proxy' entity/plugin that fronts upstream MCP servers, converting them into gateway-routed MCP traffic so consumers can use their tools, and documentation describes managing 'remote MCP traffic' with auth, routing, and observability. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation beyond first-party docs, and concrete examples of an agent actually invoking a fronted MCP server's tools end-to-end.
